source_resolution.reason: The full Menasco–Thistlethwaite proof was not retrieved after the prior five-route recovery sequence. The Annals PDF candidate returned 404, JSTOR supplied a client-challenge page, the linked UTK author route failed certificate validation, the non-www UTK route served a maintenance page, and the AMS announcement PDF returned 403. The exact UTK and AMS endpoint paths and timestamps were not retained, so they are described here without fabricated URLs. The complete Kindred alternative was read, but Theorem 5.5 is prime-link scoped and does not close the registered composite-link statement or the controlling plan's decreasing-complexity route. The theorem carrier is explicitly escalated and contains no purported proof.
source_resolution.search_summary: Earlier searches located the Annals DOI, JSTOR full-text route, a linked UTK author page, a non-www UTK host, and an AMS announcement; none yielded the complete assigned proof. A complete alternative full text by Kindred was retrieved and inspected, and its scope mismatch was recorded.

attempts.outcome: The DOI-resolved Annals route identified the source; a guessed full-PDF subpath in the prior retrieval sequence returned 404, but the exact failed subpath was not retained. This does not claim the DOI URL itself returned 404.
